outer_diameter = 40.0
wall_thickness = 0.8
length = 80.0
shoulder_length = 20.0
shoulder_diameter = 45.0
fillet_radius = 2.0

filleted = fillet(hollow.edges(), fillet_radius)

slot = Pos(40, 0, 0) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, slot_depth)

part = result

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
length = 80.0          # overall length along the slot axis (Z)
width = 60.0           # overall width across the three slots (X)
thickness = 17.0       # plate thickness (Y)

slot_width = 12.0      # width of each through slot
slot_length = 70.0     # overall length of each through slot (rounded ends)
slot_spacing = 18.0    # centre-to-centre pitch of the three slots

hole_diameter = 8.0    # small blind hole diameter
hole_depth = 10.0      # blind hole depth (from the back face)

fillet_radius = 2.0    # fillet on the outer corner edges

# Derived values
outer_radius = width / 2.0                       # 30.0
inner_radius = outer_radius - thickness          # 16.5 (slot centreline radius)
slot_radius = slot_width / 2.0                   # 6.0
slot_half = slot_length / 2.0                    # 35.0
hole_x = [inner_radius, 0.0, -inner_radius]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- outer obround body: two end cylinders joined by a rectangular web ---
    with Locations((outer_radius, 0, 0), (-outer_radius, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(outer_radius, length)
    Box(width - 2.0 * outer_radius, thickness, length)

    # --- fillet the outer corner edges (parallel to the thickness axis Y) ---
    fillet(p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), fillet_radius)

    # --- three through slots, cut through the full thickness ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with Locations((slot_spacing, 0), (0, 0), (-slot_spacing, 0)):
            SlotOverall(slot_length, slot_width)
    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- three blind holes on the back face ---
    with Locations(*[(x, -thickness / 2, 0) for x in hole_x]):
        Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, hole_depth,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MAX, Align.CENTER),
                 mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# --- Dimensions (mm) ---
bore_diameter = 31.5            # central through bore
ring_outer_diameter = 52.3      # outer diameter of the ring body
ring_thickness = 7.0            # axial thickness of the ring

petal_count = 5                 # five-petal outer profile
petal_tip_radius = 38.0         # radius to petal tips
petal_valley_radius = 24.0      # radius at petal valleys (root blend)
petal_half_angle = 18.0         # half angular width of a petal (deg)
valley_half_angle = 8.0         # half angular width of a valley (deg)

hole_count = 9                  # nine blind holes
hole_diameter = 3.5
hole_depth = 4.0                # blind depth from front face
hole_circle_radius = 22.0       # bolt circle radius

chamfer_size = 0.8              # chamfer on vertical edges

# --- Build the polar petal profile ---
pts = []
for i in range(petal_count):
    a0 = i * 360.0 / petal_count
    # valley exit -> petal tip -> valley entry (next valley)
    for ang, r in [
        (a0 - valley_half_angle, petal_valley_radius),
        (a0 - petal_half_angle, petal_tip_radius),
        (a0 + petal_half_angle, petal_tip_radius),
        (a0 + valley_half_angle, petal_valley_radius),
    ]:
        rad = math.radians(ang)
        pts.append((r * math.cos(rad), r * math.sin(rad)))

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Spline(*pts, periodic=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=ring_thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# --- Central through bore ---
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, ring_thickness / 2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2, ring_thickness + 2)

# --- Nine blind holes on front face ---
for i in range(hole_count):
    ang = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    px = hole_circle_radius * math.cos(ang)
    pz = hole_circle_radius * math.sin(ang)
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(px, ring_thickness - hole_depth / 2, pz) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, hole_depth)

# --- Chamfer vertical edges ---
vertical_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
solid_body = chamfer(vertical_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "five_petal_ring_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
strap_width = 80.0          # overall width of the flat triangular strap
strap_thickness = 7.0       # constant plate thickness
base_height = 4.0           # height of the flat base flange
apex_height = 18.0          # height of the triangular apex above the base
apex_half_width = 6.0       # half width of the rounded apex flat

window_width = 18.0         # width of each rectangular through-window
window_height = 6.5         # height of each rectangular through-window
window_center_x = 23.0      # distance of window centre from the part centre

hole_diameter = 3.5         # through-hole at the apex
hole_center_y = 12.0        # height of the apex hole above the bottom edge

clearance_diameter = 1.6    # small clearance holes flanking the apex hole
clearance_offset_x = 12.0   # lateral offset of the clearance-hole pairs
clearance_offset_z = 2.2    # offset above / below the strap mid-plane

fillet_radius = 2.9         # generous radius on the long (thickness) edges

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- flat triangular strap profile (X-Y plane) ---
    with BuildSketch() as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-strap_width / 2, 0),
                (strap_width / 2, 0),
                (strap_width / 2, base_height),
                (apex_half_width, apex_height),
                (-apex_half_width, apex_height),
                (-strap_width / 2, base_height),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=strap_thickness)

    # --- fillet the long edges that run along the strap thickness ---
    long_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    try:
        fillet(long_edges, fillet_radius)
    except Exception:
        # fall back to a smaller radius if the generous one fails
        fillet(long_edges, fillet_radius * 0.6)

    # --- two rectangular through-windows, one in each arm ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations((-window_center_x, base_height / 2),
                       (window_center_x, base_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(window_width, window_height)
    extrude(amount=strap_thickness, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- through-hole at the apex ---
    with Locations((0, hole_center_y, strap_thickness / 2)):
        Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, strap_thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- small clearance holes flanking the apex hole ---
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        for sz in (-1, 1):
            with Locations((sx * clearance_offset_x,
                            hole_center_y,
                            strap_thickness / 2 + sz * clearance_offset_z)):
                Cylinder(clearance_diameter / 2,
                         strap_thickness * 2,
                         rotation=(90, 0, 0),
                         mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
strip_width = 19.2          # width of the flat strip (X)
strip_thickness = 5.8       # thickness of the strip (Y)
half_length = 40.0          # half of the overall strip length (Z)

# serpentine centre-line: Z -> X offset
x_mid = 6.5                 # offset of the mid segment
x_end = 12.5                # offset of the end segments
z_mid = 15.0                # end of the first diagonal run
z_mid2 = 25.0               # start of the second diagonal run

# rounded (eye) ends
eye_radius = 5.2

# punched through-slots in the diagonal runs
slot_width = 4.6
slot_length = 12.0
slot_pitch = 14.0
slot_rows = 2

# small through-holes in the mid segment
hole_dia = 1.8
hole_pitch = 14.0
hole_rows = 2

# edge break
chamfer_size = 0.5

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- serpentine strip body -------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as profile:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-x_end, -half_length),
                (-x_mid, -z_mid),
                (x_mid, -z_mid2),
                (x_mid, z_mid2),
                (-x_mid, z_mid),
                (-x_end, half_length),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=strip_thickness / 2, both=True)

    # ---- rounded eye ends ------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, half_length)):
        Cylinder(eye_radius, strip_thickness, rotation=(90, 0, 0))
    with Locations((0, 0, -half_length)):
        Cylinder(eye_radius, strip_thickness, rotation=(90, 0, 0))

    # ---- punched through-slots in the diagonal runs ----------------
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        z0 = sgn * z_mid
        z1 = sgn * z_mid2
        x0 = sgn * x_mid
        x1 = sgn * x_mid
        dz = z1 - z0
        ux, uz = 0.0, dz / (dz ** 2) ** 0.5          # run direction (in XZ)
        nx, nz = -uz, ux                             # normal to the run
        ang = 90.0 * uz                              # rotation about Y
        for i in range(slot_rows):
            t = (i + 1) * slot_pitch / (slot_rows + 1)
            xc = x0 + (x1 - x0) * t
            zc = z0 + dz * t
            with Locations(Location((xc, 0, zc), (0, ang, 0))):
                Box(slot_width, strip_thickness * 3, slot_length,
                    mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- small through-holes in the mid segment --------------------
    for i in range(hole_rows):
        zc = (i - (hole_rows - 1) / 2) * hole_pitch
        with Locations((x_mid, 0, zc)):
            Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, strip_thickness * 3, rotation=(0, 90, 0),
                     mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer the long edges ------------------------------------
    long_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if e.length > 2.0
        and abs(e.tangent_at(0.5).Z) > 0.95     # edges running along the strip
    ]
    chamfer(long_edges, chamfer_size)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# Parameters (mm)

neck_half_width = 4.5          # half width of the narrow necked middle section

set_screw_z = (33.0, 47.0)     # axial positions of the two set-screw holes

pocket_width = 6.4             # lightening pocket width
pocket_z = (12.0, 20.5, 59.5, 68.0)   # pocket centers along the arms

fillet_radius = 0.6            # small fillet on the long (extrusion) edges

# Build

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as prof:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-half_width, -plate_thickness / 2),
                (half_width, -plate_thickness / 2),
                (half_width, -1.2),
                (neck_half_width, -1.2),
                (neck_half_width, 1.2),
                (half_width, 1.2),
                (half_width, plate_thickness / 2),
                (-half_width, plate_thickness / 2),
                (-half_width, 1.2),
                (-neck_half_width, 1.2),
                (-neck_half_width, -1.2),
                (-half_width, -1.2),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

    # --- straight necked middle portion --------------------------------------
    with BuildLine() as l_neck:
        Line((0, 0, z_neck_start), (0, 0, z_neck_end))
    sweep(sections=prof.sketch, path=l_neck.line)

    # --- upper curved arm ----------------------------------------------------
    with BuildLine() as l_up:
        ThreePointArc(
            (0, 0, z_neck_end),
            (-arm_center_radius, 0, z_neck_end + arm_center_radius),
            (-arm_center_radius, 0, z_neck_end + arm_center_radius * 2),
        )
    sweep(sections=prof.sketch, path=l_up.line)

    # --- lower curved arm ----------------------------------------------------
    with BuildLine() as l_lo:
        ThreePointArc(
            (0, 0, z_neck_start),
            (arm_center_radius, 0, z_neck_start - arm_center_radius),
            (arm_center_radius, 0, z_neck_start - arm_center_radius * 2),
        )
    sweep(sections=prof.sketch, path=l_lo.line)

    # --- lightening pockets in the arms --------------------------------------
    for zc in pocket_z:
        with Locations((0, 0, zc)):
            Box(
                pocket_width,
                plate_thickness + 10.0,
                pocket_len,
                mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,

    # --- set-screw holes through the neck (along X) --------------------------
    for zc in set_screw_z:

            Cylinder(
                set_screw_dia / 2,
                half_width * 2 + 10.0,
                rotation=(0, 90, 0),
                mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
            )

    # --- eye holes at the arm ends (along the bend axis) ---------------------
    for zc in (total_length, 0.0):

                eye_hole_dia / 2,
                plate_thickness + 10.0,
                rotation=(90, 0, 0),
                mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
            )

    # --- small fillets on the long (extrusion) edges -------------------------
    try:

    except Exception:

from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
flange_thickness = 5.0
hub_diameter = 30.0
hub_length = 15.0
shaft_diameter = 14.0
shaft_length = 40.0
slot_width = 8.0
slot_length = 30.0
slot_count = 4
chamfer_size = 0.5

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
hub_radius = hub_diameter / 2.0
shaft_radius = shaft_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, flange_thickness))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (hub_radius, flange_thickness))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (hub_radius, flange_thickness + hub_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (shaft_radius, flange_thickness + hub_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (shaft_radius, flange_thickness + hub_length + shaft_length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, flange_thickness + hub_length + shaft_length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_size)

slot_center_radius = outer_radius - slot_length / 2.0
for i in range(slot_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / slot_count)
    px = slot_center_radius * math.cos(angle)
    pz = slot_center_radius * math.sin(angle)
    slot = Pos(px, flange_thickness / 2.0, pz) * Box(slot_length, flange_thickness, slot_width)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

part = solid_body
part.name = "flange_hub_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - compact locknut / set-screw retaining nut
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
body_len = 80.0            # overall length
body_dia = 28.0            # main cylindrical body diameter
neck_dia = 20.5            # reduced neck (threaded portion) diameter
neck_len = 12.0            # neck length
boss_dia = 11.5            # small end boss diameter
boss_len = 8.0             # boss length
knurl_pitch = 5.0          # knurl band pitch
knurl_band = 3.0           # raised knurl band width
knurl_depth = 1.2          # knurl radial depth
knurl_start = 14.0         # first knurl band position
knurl_end = 62.0           # last knurl band position
pocket_w = 16.0            # rectangular side pocket width
pocket_h = 8.0             # rectangular side pocket height
pocket_depth = 5.0         # pocket depth into the body
pocket_z = 40.0            # pocket axial position
set_screw_dia = 4.0        # set-screw hole diameter
set_screw_head_dia = 7.7   # set-screw head diameter
set_screw_head_depth = 3.0 # set-screw head recess depth
set_screw_z = 12.0         # set-screw hole axial position
chamfer_size = 0.8         # small edge chamfer

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Revolved profile (X = radius, Z = axis)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (0, 0),
                (body_dia / 2, 0),
                (body_dia / 2, body_len - neck_len - boss_len),
                (neck_dia / 2, body_len - neck_len - boss_len),
                (neck_dia / 2, body_len - boss_len),
                (boss_dia / 2, body_len - boss_len),
                (boss_dia / 2, body_len),
                (0, body_len),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Knurl bands: alternating raised / recessed rings on the main body
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pos = knurl_start
while pos + knurl_band <= knurl_end:
    band = Pos(0, 0, pos + knurl_band / 2) * Cylinder(
        body_dia / 2 + knurl_depth, knurl_band
    )
    solid_body = solid_body + band
    pos += knurl_pitch

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rectangular side pocket (blind, into the body wall)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pocket = Pos(-body_dia / 2 + pocket_depth / 2, 0, pocket_z) * Box(
    pocket_depth, pocket_w, pocket_h
)
solid_body = solid_body - pocket

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set-screw hole through the side wall + counterbored head recess
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hole = Pos(-body_dia / 2, 0, set_screw_z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(
    set_screw_dia / 2, body_dia
)
solid_body = solid_body - hole

head = Pos(-body_dia / 2 + set_screw_head_depth / 2, 0, set_screw_z) * Rot(
    90, 0, 0
) * Cylinder(set_screw_head_dia / 2, set_screw_head_depth)
solid_body = solid_body - head

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Small chamfer on the outer rim edges (bottom face and top boss face)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rim_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6 or abs(e.center().Z - body_len) < 1e-6
)
solid_body = chamfer(rim_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "locknut_with_knurl"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

channel_length = 80.0
channel_width = 50.0
channel_height = 30.0
wall_thickness = 10.0
fillet_radius = 2.0
hole_diameter = 5.0
hole_spacing = 20.0

outer_width = channel_width + 2 * wall_thickness
outer_height = channel_height + 2 * wall_thickness

base = Box(outer_width, outer_height, channel_length)
inner = Pos(-wall_thickness/2, -wall_thickness/2, 0) * Box(channel_width, channel_height, channel_length)
solid_body = base - inner

y_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
pos_x_edges = [e for e in y_edges if e.center().X > 0]
solid_body = fillet(pos_x_edges, fillet_radius)

hole_r = hole_diameter / 2
hole_h = channel_length + 20
for x_pos in [outer_width/2, -outer_width/2]:
    for z_pos in [-hole_spacing/2, hole_spacing/2]:
        solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x_pos, 0, z_pos) * Cylinder(hole_r, hole_h)

part = solid_body
part.name = "channel_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

channel_width = 70.0
channel_height = 45.0
wall_thickness = 12.0
channel_length = 80.0
fillet_radius = 2.0
hole_diameter = 5.0
hole_spacing = 20.0
hole_offset = 10.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (channel_width, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (channel_width, channel_height))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (channel_width - wall_thickness, channel_height))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (channel_width - wall_thickness, wall_thickness))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0, wall_thickness))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=channel_length)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y), fillet_radius)

hole_r = hole_diameter / 2
hole_h = channel_length + 10
for i in range(3):
    x = hole_offset + i * hole_spacing
    y = channel_height / 2
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, channel_length / 2) * Cylinder(hole_r, hole_h)

part = solid_body
part.name = "C_channel_with_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
thickness = 5.5                 # plate thickness
bore_dia = 17.3                 # central through bore
lobe_major = 30.0               # lobe overall length (X)
lobe_minor = 24.0               # lobe overall width  (Y)
lobe_offset_x = 20.0            # lobe centre offset in X
lobe_offset_y = 16.0            # lobe centre offset in Y
slot_width = 7.5                # straight slot width
slot_length = 15.0              # straight slot length
slot_fillet = 1.0               # slot end fillet radius
slot_pitch = 22.0               # slot centre-to-centre pitch
chamfer_size = 0.8              # edge break chamfer

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- flat outline: two overlapping elliptical lobes ---------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with Locations((-lobe_offset_x, lobe_offset_y)):
            Ellipse(lobe_major / 2, lobe_minor / 2)
        with Locations((lobe_offset_x, -lobe_offset_y)):
            Ellipse(lobe_major / 2, lobe_minor / 2)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

    # ---- central through bore ----------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, thickness / 2)):
        Cylinder(bore_dia / 2, thickness * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- straight slots, two per lobe --------------------------------------
    slot_centers = []
    for sx, sy in ((-1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for k in (-0.5, 0.5):
            slot_centers.append((sx * lobe_offset_x + k * slot_pitch,
                                 sy * lobe_offset_y))

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as slot_sk:
        with Locations(*slot_centers):
            Rectangle(slot_width, slot_length)
    extrude(amount=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- fillet the slot ends (vertical edges of the slot cuts) ------------
    slot_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
        if abs(e.center().Z - thickness / 2) < 1e-6
        and min(abs(abs(e.center().X) - slot_width / 2),
                abs(abs(e.center().Y) - slot_length / 2)) < 1e-6
    ]
    if slot_edges:
        fillet(slot_edges, slot_fillet)

    # ---- break every remaining sharp vertical edge -------------------------
    sharp_edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if sharp_edges:
        chamfer(sharp_edges, chamfer_size)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stylised double-loop / figure-eight decorative plate
#   * closed outer contour: two large lobes + small central lower lobe
#   * one central through hole
#   * two obround through slots per lobe (four total)
#   * small through hole in the central lobe
#   * uniform plate thickness, gently drafted side walls
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

plate_thickness = 5.5          # mm, uniform plate thickness
draft_angle     = 2.0          # deg, slight draft on the side walls

# --- outer contour (three fused circles) ------------------------------
lobe_radius   = 25.0           # large upper / lower lobes
lobe_offset_x = 20.0
lobe_offset_y = 15.0
center_radius = 12.0           # small central lower lobe
center_y      = -18.0

# --- central through hole --------------------------------------------
central_hole_radius = 8.5

# --- obround slots ----------------------------------------------------
slot_length    = 14.0          # overall slot length (along Y)
slot_width     = 7.0
slot_pitch_x   = 24.0          # horizontal spacing of the two slots
slot_center_y  = 12.0          # slot row height within each lobe

# --- small hole in the central lobe ----------------------------------
center_hole_radius = 3.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- closed outer profile ---------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as outer_sk:
        with Locations((lobe_offset_x,  lobe_offset_y)):
            Circle(lobe_radius)
        with Locations((-lobe_offset_x, lobe_offset_y)):
            Circle(lobe_radius)
        with Locations((0.0, center_y)):
            Circle(center_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, taper=draft_angle)

    # ---- central through hole --------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as hole_sk:
        Circle(central_hole_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- two obround slots in each large lobe -----------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as slot_sk:
        with Locations(
            (-slot_pitch_x / 2, lobe_offset_y + slot_center_y),
            ( slot_pitch_x / 2, lobe_offset_y + slot_center_y),
            (-slot_pitch_x / 2, -lobe_offset_y + slot_center_y),
            ( slot_pitch_x / 2, -lobe_offset_y + slot_center_y),
        ):
            SlotOverall(slot_length, slot_width)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- small through hole in the central lobe ---------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as c_hole_sk:
        with Locations((0.0, center_y)):
            Circle(center_hole_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_thickness = 10.0          # flat plate thickness
central_bore_dia = 26.7         # large central through bore

lobe_count = 8                  # eight lobes around the centre
lobe_pitch_radius = 28.66       # radial position of lobe hole centres
lobe_hole_dia = 12.4            # round hole inside each lobe
lobe_outer_dia = 39.0           # outside diameter of each lobe (overlap -> one piece)

slot_count = 16                 # sixteen small round through holes
slot_pitch_radius = 14.33       # radial position of the small holes
slot_hole_dia = 11.7

edge_fillet = 0.5               # small edge fillet on the outer profile

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the plate
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        # solid disc large enough to contain every lobe
        Circle(lobe_pitch_radius + lobe_outer_dia / 2)

        # eight lobes -> unioned into a single connected body
        with PolarLocations(lobe_pitch_radius, lobe_count):
            Circle(lobe_outer_dia / 2)

        # central bore
        Circle(central_bore_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # eight round holes, one per lobe
        with PolarLocations(lobe_pitch_radius, lobe_count):
            Circle(lobe_hole_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # sixteen small round through holes on the inner circle
        with PolarLocations(slot_pitch_radius, slot_count, start_angle=22.5):
            Circle(slot_hole_dia / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

solid_body = p.part

# fillet the outer perimeter edges (top and bottom face boundaries)
outer_edges = solid_body.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
solid_body = fillet(outer_edges, edge_fillet)
